summary: Timeboxed minimal raw payload access for regulatory evidence — limited slice inspection
description:
Issue summary:
A regulatory body (foreign financial regulator) has requested a narrow sample of raw request/response payloads for one customer's high-severity allegation. Legal has requested a minimal, timeboxed access to production raw payloads and associated audit logs strictly scoped to the impacted customer and timeframe.

Impact:
- Request is time-sensitive (regulator deadline in 5 business days).
- Access must be provable/auditable and redacted to remove unrelated PII.
- Any extract must not expose other customers or broader telemetry.

Request details / scope:
- Provide a minimal set of inference request/response payloads for customer-customer_omega between 2026-02-12T00:00:00Z and 2026-02-12T23:59:59Z (UTC).
- Include associated API audit logs, auth headers metadata (key IDs only, not full keys), and routing metadata needed for timeline reconstruction.
- Exclude any unrelated customer payloads.
- Redaction: substitute or remove user-provided PII fields (emails, SSNs, account numbers) per the attached redaction spec (confluence link).

Environment:
- prod (us-east-1) serving-runtime and audit-logs.

Steps to reproduce / access path (requested):
1) Query audit index for customer_id: customer_omega and timestamp range.
2) Pull associated raw payload blobs stored in object store (internal path masked) and mount to ephemeral analysis workspace.
3) Run automated redaction script (approved pattern file) and produce final zip with manifest and hash.

Logs / links:
- Suspected incident timeline: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0312-omega
- Redaction runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COMPLIANCE/Legal+Evidence+Collection+Runbook

Approvals required before any extract:
1) Compliance sign-off (legal@redwood.ai).
2) Engineering owner (serving-runtime) approval for any trace mounting.
3) SRE on-call to supervise ephemeral workspace and network egress controls.

Proposed controls / safeguards (requested):
- Timebound access window: 48 hours of workspace availability; extract snapshot to be purged after 7 days.
- Least-privileged service account with short-lived tokens generated via Vault, auditable via KMS logs.
- Automated redaction pass mandatory before handing to regulator; manual verification by Compliance.
- Audit entries for every action (who/downloaded/hashed) to be attached to ticket.

Desired delivery ETA:
- Proof-of-slice (redaction script run on a 3-record sample) within 48 hours of approval.
- Full timeboxed extract delivered within 96 hours after approvals, subject to SRE windows.

Notes:
- Legal emphasized zero-tolerance for over-broad extracts.
- This is not a blanket data export; narrow-scope only.
comments: Aisha Marquez (2026-03-10): Filed per inbound legal request. Attached regulator contact and deadline. Asking for SRE on-call to confirm feasibility and any blocker for object-store snapshot access.
Liam O'Connor (2026-03-10): Acknowledged. Tagging @SRE-oncall and @Compliance. Need clarification on acceptable redaction patterns and whether KMS/HSM hashes are sufficient for audit trail.

Compliance (Maya Patel) (2026-03-11): Confirmed redaction patterns; provided confluence doc and a signed legal subpoena copy. Compliance requires manual sign-off after automated redact pass and wants MD5+SHA256 hashes of artifacts.

SRE (Rajat Singh) (2026-03-12): Feasibility check: we can produce timeboxed mount with ephemeral role. Two blockers: (1) current object-store retention rules require an admin assist to snapshot older blobs, (2) need Vault role creation for the ephemeral service account. Est ETA for prep: 24–36 hours pending approvals.
investigation_notes: Hypotheses considered: (a) requested data exists in object-store indexed by request_id -> success; (b) some payloads may have been truncated by prefix caching / batching optimization — will verify presence of full payloads. Initial audit query returned ~12 candidate requests in the timeframe. Need to confirm payload completeness and whether KV-cache-only responses exist (which would not have persisted full blobs).
current_plan: 1) Obtain Compliance & Legal sign-off (Maya). 2) Create ephemeral Vault role and short-lived token; SRE to snapshot required blobs into an isolated bucket. 3) Run approved redaction script in ephemeral workspace; Compliance to verify. 4) Produce final bundle with manifest + hashes and upload to secured evidence share. 5) Purge workspace and snapshot after confirmation. Estimated timeline after approvals: 48–72 hours.
notes_for_audit: All actions must be logged under the ticket ID INT-903957. SRE to attach KMS logs, Vault issuance logs, and object-store access logs. Redaction script version and commit: infra/tools/redact:v2.3 (PR attached).
